question: What worldly honor and final destination are promised to the devotee of this hymn?
premises: The devotee may be honored by Kubera and others.
The devotee will depart at the end of life.
The destination is the abode of Śrī.
inference: The devotee gains honor in life and reaches Śrī's abode at death.
plain_english: One may be honored by the lord of wealth and others, and at the time of death will go to the abode of Śrī.
